evals.prompt: 把官方示例纸样生成真实三角网格，导出 GLB 并给我可旋转的离线三维预览。暂时不做物理仿真，界面要明确标注未仿真。
evals.expected_output: Valid generated mesh and GLB, offline preview, source attribution and honest un-simulated status.
assertions: Exports a nonempty GLB mesh with finite vertices and valid triangles
Preview clearly labels the initial mesh as not physically simulated
Preserves input SHA-256 and identifies the official repository fixture rather than a dataset row

evals.prompt: 这是 random_body 目录中的一个 GarmentCodeData 纸样；我只有纸样和身体测量，没有对应人体网格。请给我这个人的物理试穿预览，不要换成平均人体。
evals.expected_output: Specific missing-body error, no fabricated personal-fit simulation or neutral-body replacement.
assertions: Rejects custom-fit draping without the matching body mesh
Does not silently substitute the neutral body
Reports the exact missing input needed to continue

evals.prompt: 我只有一份已有 garment.glb，没有原始纸样和 GarmentCode 仓库；不要重新仿真。请保持米单位，输出可离线旋转的线框查看器和 GLB，记录真实输入哈希。
evals.expected_output: Loads the existing mesh with process=False, exports the preview, and does not claim new meshing or simulation.
assertions: Existing GLB alone exports a loadable mesh and offline HTML without pattern/repository input
Reloaded exported positions and indices preserve meter-scale input geometry
Manifest records the actual existing-mesh hash and no newly generated mesh or simulation
Existing preview is clearly labeled and physical-fit status remains NOT_RUN

evals.prompt: 用官方上衣纸样与 mean_all 人体做真实 CPU 下垂仿真，保存初始和最终 GLB、离线 HTML 与 manifest。请区分计算完成、上游阈值、零穿透和实体合身，保留原始几何，不要修饰质量结论。
evals.expected_output: Actual CPU XPBD drape, input/source provenance, independently readable initial/final meshes, separate permissive/strict/fit states.
assertions: CPU XPBD actually executes beyond the early-static bug and ends without a runtime error
Real initial and final GLBs have valid identical topology and measurable deformation
Input hash and upstream source revision identify the official fixture
Manifest separates permissive thresholds from strict zero-intersection outcomes
Independent full garment audit and physical fit remain NOT_RUN
Preview label does not upgrade permissive threshold success to garment-quality approval
